Ask for the slide-by-slide plan before any pixels. The prompt keeps
one message per slide, a fixed portrait canvas, and a short list of
things the picture must not do. Set `n` and the topic in the last
line.

```text
Create a new, original $n$-slide LinkedIn educational carousel using the same overall graphic language (with n the number of slides to generate)

Design requirements:
- Portrait 4:5 (1080 × 1350 px).
- White backgrounds and generous whitespace.
- DM Sans SemiBold headings and Inter body text.
- Dark charcoal typography with forest-green and pale-mint accents.
- Minimalist scientific vector illustrations using cells, nuclei, DNA, RNA and molecular structures.
- Subtle, low-contrast genomic background patterns.
- One clear educational message per slide.
- Consistent margins, heading hierarchy and footers.
- No photographs, 3D rendering, gradients or clutter.
- No copied logos or publisher branding.

First develop slide-by-slide content and visual concepts. Then create the illustrations separately from the text and produce an editable slide layout.
Preserve scientific accuracy and flag claims requiring verification.

My topic is: [INSERT TOPIC].
```
